title: Avocado Plus Adjustable Base
body_html: Premium adjustable bases usually mean more of what you'd rather not see — more plastic, more black steel, more equipment. The Avocado Plus Adjustable Base is built to disappear: a low-profile, zero-clearance frame wrapped in organic cotton over organic wool padding, standing on adjustable natural wood legs (real wood, not plastic), with a 3" padded shroud that hides the hardware so it sits clean on a platform bed. Underneath the calm, it does everything — independent head and foot adjustment to help ease snoring, reflux, and back tension, then massage, lumbar support, automatic head tilt, app control, and soft underbed lighting layered on top. Total wellness, plus every comfort — built to the material standard of your Avocado mattress set.

title: Wood Swatch Set
body_html: Order a wood swatch set to experience the solid wood species and premium finishes used in Avocado furniture — from Alder/Blonde and Walnut to reclaimed and solid Oak. Swatches are 3" x 3". We make our solid wood furniture in our woodshops, where we combine high-tech capabilities with traditional craftsmanship. Our hand-rubbed and spray-applied coatings elevate durability, beauty, and sustainability. Please note that, because our furniture is crafted and finished by hand, there may be slight differences between the sample and the end product. Read about the Wood Species & Finishes Uses in Avocado Furniture.

title: Organic Cotton Sheets 600TC
body_html: Ridiculously soft and organic, our Organic Cotton Sheets have a sateen finish for a lustrous sheen and a luxurious, satiny feel. Available in 600 two-ply (196 warp / 104 weft), where each yarn is made from two threads twisted together, creating a denser and more luxurious fabric. Made with GOTS-certified organic cotton from India or Pakistan and are naturally wrinkle-resistant.

title: Grand Luxe Mattress Topper
body_html: The Grand Luxe Mattress Topper brings the layered luxury of our Grand Luxe Mattress to the bed you already own. British wool from the United Kingdom. Ultra-soft Pure Talalay® latex over thousands of individually responsive microcoils. Four layers of finely blended organic cotton, organic wool, and natural silk for breathable loft. Needle-tufted by hand in California. Medium in feel, sitting nearer Firm than Plush — supple at the surface, buoyant and supportive beneath.

title: Organic Crib Mattress Pad Protector
body_html: To protect your baby's crib mattress from spills, stains, sweat, skin oils, and baby's little accidents, we made our Organic Crib Mattress Pad. Made with organic cotton sateen and certified to MADE SAFE® standards, it's an organic — absorbent, never waterproof — alternative to plastic-based waterproof crib protectors. No polyurethane, TPUs, formaldehyde, PVCs, vinyls, laminates, adhesives, chemical finishes, or waterproof coatings. For the purist who wants zero synthetic waterproofing in the crib, this GOTS-certified organic crib mattress pad is for you. Available in Crib (53.5" x 29.5") and Mini Crib (38.5" x 24.5") sizes, each with a 7" pocket. It pairs beautifully with any of our Organic Crib Mattresses and organic crib sheets. If you need a liquid barrier, opt for our Organic Waterproof Crib Protector.

title: Avocado Adjustable Base
body_html: Most adjustable bases are exposed black steel — something to hide. The Avocado Adjustable Base is built to disappear: set it on a platform, across slats, inside a frame, or freestanding on its own adjustable natural wood legs (real wood, not plastic). A low-profile, zero-clearance frame, wrapped in organic cotton, blends into your bedroom and matches your Avocado mattress, while the head and foot adjust independently to ease snoring, reflux, and back tension. This unique adjustable base completes your sleep setup without looking like one.

title: Organic Kids Pillow
body_html: When your child outgrows the Organic Toddler Pillow, the Avocado Organic Kids Pillow is the next step. It's a full-size pillow — 19" × 25", the same footprint as our adult Green Pillow — tuned with a lower, gentler loft made for your growing child. It's a GOTS-certified organic pillow (CU863637), certified as a finished product from farm to finished pillow — not just one material inside it — and crafted with an organic cotton shell, shredded organic latex, and organic kapok fiber. No synthetic microfiber, polyester, PLA (plant-based plastic), or polyamide fibers are used. Designed for kids ages 3 and up, it's intentionally sewn shut—no zippers, no removable fill—for safer, simpler sleep. It also meets the strictest non-toxic certifications, including OEKO-TEX® Standard 100 Class I — the most restrictive tier, designed for products used by babies and children — and MADE SAFE®.

title: Dorm Room Bundle
body_html: Prepare for a restful, healthy school year with Avocado's Back to School Bundle. Perfect for upgrading any dorm room, this eco-conscious set includes our premium Eco Organic Mattress Topper made from FSC-certified Pure Talalay latex and a supportive, GOTS-certified organic Avocado Green Pillow. Create a non-toxic, sustainable sleep space that feels like home—and save 15% when you shop the bundle. Discount automatically applied to your cart.
